method.timeResolution: Workflow and job timestamps are UTC milliseconds; UI duration is rounded to whole seconds by the E2E spec.
method.queueToExtractionStart: Job createdAt through extractStep first startedAt. Includes upload finalization/dispatch, claimRunStep, and local workflow scheduling.
method.extractionStep: extractStep first startedAt through completedAt. Includes storage read, digest/size validation, document rendering, QR extraction, OCR, and result/DB persistence; not pure OCR CPU time.
method.betweenExtractionAndSubmission: extractStep completedAt through submitStep startedAt; workflow scheduling between stages.
method.submissionOrGatingStep: submitStep startedAt through completedAt. Includes OCR/QR quality gates, record RPC reads, relayer lease/encryption/signing/broadcast and DB operations when accepted. For rejected documents this is gating only.
method.postSubmissionToFinalConclusionStart: submitStep completedAt through last concludeStep startedAt. Includes earlier bounded confirmation polls and 10-second Workflow sleeps.
method.finalConclusionStep: Last concludeStep startedAt through completedAt for a terminal job. Includes receipt/confirmation checks, permitted Zama decryption, record rechecks, and result persistence; not pure decryption time.
method.checkedAtTimestampBasis: For found records packages/chain/src/shared.ts stores new Date(block.timestamp*1000) as checkedAt. Retained as snapshot evidence, excluded from elapsed timers; other rejection paths can use inspectCredential() or finish() wall-clock values.
method.serverCreatedToFinalStageCompletion: Job createdAt through final concludeStep completedAt, or submitStep completedAt for a rejection without comparison.
method.uiSecondsToResult: Timer starts immediately before clicking Verifikasi Dokumen and is sampled after waiting for expected result heading, fetching latestJob, and taking screenshot. Includes evidence overhead and UI polling.
method.retries: Step startedAt is retained from first attempt. attempt count and whitelisted step_retrying events are retained; individual lifecycle timestamps are available in events.
method.confirmationPure: Unavailable: application does not store separate broadcast/confirmation boundary timestamps. Receipt block time belongs in separate receipt evidence, not reconstructed as an exact elapsed timer.
method.decryptionPure: Unavailable: application does not instrument the start/end of userDecrypt separately.
method.runCompletedAt: Excluded from total duration: Workflow sleeps one hour after the decision before cleanup.
method.issuanceUiTimings: secondsToEncryptedReview starts before Siapkan data untuk ditinjau and ends after review checkbox is checked. secondsToConfirmedIssuance uses the same start and ends when the confirmed issuance heading is visible; includes encryption, review/wallet UI signing, submission and confirmations, not pure chain confirmation.
method.sampleInterpretation: One observed run with several different synthetic scenarios; no percentiles, throughput claim, or representative benchmark.

environment.database: local PostgreSQL Docker verifikasi-uas-pg, application database verifikasi_local; no production query
environment.workflow: Next.js Workflow local world; metadata apps/web/.next/workflow-data. Next withWorkflow sets this path.

limitations: Two observations per repeated comparison scenario with different credential IDs/PDFs; small samples, no percentiles or representative throughput claim.
Original UI workflow has no pure confirmation, userDecrypt or OCR CPU timer. Their null values indicate unavailable measurements.
checkedAt for found records is the confirmed blockchain snapshot timestamp and is excluded from elapsed durations.
The interrupted earlier run contains a NOT_FOUND result for a flawed foreign-fixture assertion. It is retained as an observed result, not a successful full test run.
Local process/service caches were not independently controlled; repeated runs and follow-up decryption must be labeled with their actual method.
